subject: Dataset certification & MAP for evaluation run
messages:
From: Samir Goyal <samir.goyal@brightretail.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: eval-ops@brightretail.com
Date: 2025-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial dataset exchange + MAP ask

Neha — thanks again for the demo last week. We want to move forward with the 2-week eval you showed (search/qa throughput + relevance tests). Before we start, ops needs a quick mutual action plan and the sample files we can ingest into our staging run.

Attached is a simple manifest that describes the candidate files we can share from our side (names and hashes) — these are representative snapshots, not production PII. Ops questions: retention window for the samples, allowed usage (can we use them for feature tuning or only acceptance tests?), and whether Redwood requires a signed SOW for sample exchange.

Can you share a MAP draft and any ingestion constraints by EOD tomorrow? We’d like the data in our staging by 6/18.

Attachments: brightretail_eval_manifest.csv (list of sample files, sizes, checksums)

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Goyal
Head of Data Partnerships — BrightRetail
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Goyal <samir.goyal@brightretail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-10T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial dataset exchange + MAP ask

Samir — appreciate the clear ask and the manifest. I pulled together a short MAP and a certification checklist that should address your ops questions. High level:

- Scope: You provide the evaluation snapshots listed in the manifest. Redwood will only use these for the agreed acceptance tests (QA metrics, latency and relevance validation).
- Prohibited uses: No model training, no redistribution outside BrightRetail + Redwood test teams.
- Retention: Redwood will retain ingested snapshots for 30 days post-acceptance by default; extended retention can be added to the SOW.
- Data handling: We ask that samples are pre-sanitized of direct PII; if any sensitive fields remain, we will agree on redaction rules prior to ingestion.
- Acceptance criteria: (1) sample ingestion success rate >=95% in staging, (2) end-to-end testcases for top-10 queries pass relevance threshold, (3) no unexpected data egress alerts in the first 72h.
- Timeline suggestion (draft MAP):
  * 6/12 — exchange final sample tar + signed MAP (email confirmation OK)
  * 6/13–6/16 — Redwood ingest + smoke tests in staging
  * 6/17 — run acceptance testcases, share results
  * 6/18 — decision/feedback and next steps (canary or expand)

I attached a MAP draft and a small ingestion-template.csv that maps filenames to dataset IDs we use internally. Please review and flag anything that won't work for your ops team.

Note on attachments and compliance: we can supply SOC2 attestation pages and an audit log export for this ingest on request — Marissa will coordinate the compliance artifacts and SOW language.

Attachments: MAP-BrightRetail-v1.docx, ingestion-template.csv

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Samir Goyal <samir.goyal@brightretail.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-11T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial dataset exchange + MAP ask

Samir — quick commercial note while Neha and Marissa finalize the MAP: assuming acceptance on 6/18, we can commit to a one-week canary in production routing with dedicated capacity for the eval (if you want predictable latency). Pricing for the canary is standard usage + a short reserved overlay — I’ll have Finance send a one-page quote to you today.

A few asks from our side so legal/procurement can move fast:
- Confirm the primary SOW signatory and billing entity.
- Confirm whether BrightRetail requires a PO prior to sample exchange or after acceptance.

If those two items look good we can table the SOW and have DocuSign ready the same day the MAP is approved.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Goyal <samir.goyal@brightretail.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-12T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial dataset exchange + MAP ask

Looping in final legal/governance notes. Samir — the MAP Neha shared is fine from an operations perspective; a couple of clarifications we need to put in the SOW and the exchange checklist:

- Data Classification: confirm that the shared snapshots are classified as "Non-PII / Controlled" in your registry (we'll accept limited PII only under an approved redaction plan).
- Liability and IP: samples used for acceptance remain the property of BrightRetail; Redwood will not claim IP on the snapshots or derived evaluation logs.
- Auditability: Redwood will provide a one-time audit-log export for the ingest and a short report summarizing acceptance test results.
- Procurement: we can proceed with sample exchange upon email approval of the MAP. For the SOW signature and billing, please sign the attached SOW and hit the DocuSign link when ready.

DocuSign and quote references included below. Once we have the signed MAP + SOW (or email approval for the MAP plus signed SOW), Ops will schedule the ingestion window and Neha's team will run the acceptance testcases.

Attachments: SOW-BrightRetail-v1.pdf

-Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
